analytics.name: analytics
analytics.description: SQL query execution against Databricks SQL Warehouses

required.description: SQL Warehouse for executing analytics queries

postScaffold.instruction: Ensure your SQL Warehouse is running and accessible from your workspace.
Create a config/queries/ directory and add .sql files for your analytics queries.

files.name: files
files.description: File operations against Databricks Volumes and Unity Catalog

postScaffold.instruction: Verify your Unity Catalog volume exists and you have WRITE_VOLUME permission.
Set the DATABRICKS_VOLUME_FILES environment variable to the full volume path (e.g. /Volumes/catalog/schema/volume_name).

genie.name: genie
genie.description: AI/BI Genie space integration for natural language data queries

required.description: Genie Space for AI-powered data queries. Space IDs configured via plugin config.

postScaffold.instruction: Configure the 'spaces' map in your plugin config with alias-to-Space-ID mappings.
Ensure your Genie Space(s) are configured with the appropriate data tables and instructions.

required.description: A Databricks job to trigger and monitor

id.description: Numeric Databricks job ID. Find it in the Jobs UI or via `databricks jobs list`.

lakebase.name: lakebase
lakebase.description: SQL query execution against Databricks Lakebase Autoscaling

required.description: Lakebase Postgres database for persistent storage

branch.description: Full Lakebase Postgres branch resource name. Obtain by running `databricks postgres list-branches projects/{project-id}`, select the desired item from the output array and use its .name value.

database.description: Full Lakebase Postgres database resource name. Obtain by running `databricks postgres list-databases {branch-name}`, select the desired item from the output array and use its .name value. Requires the branch resource name.

host.description: Postgres host for local development. Auto-injected by the platform at deploy time.

databaseName.description: Postgres database name for local development. Auto-injected by the platform at deploy time.

endpointPath.description: Lakebase endpoint resource name. Auto-injected at runtime via app.yaml valueFrom: postgres. For local development, obtain by running `databricks postgres list-endpoints {branch-name}`, select the desired item from the output array and use its .name value.

port.description: Postgres port. Auto-injected by the platform at deploy time.

sslmode.description: Postgres SSL mode. Auto-injected by the platform at deploy time.

postScaffold.instruction: Run database migrations to initialize your Lakebase schema.
Verify local connectivity to Lakebase using: PGHOST=<host> PGDATABASE=<db> PGPORT=5432 PGSSLMODE=require psql

server.name: server
server.description: HTTP server with Express, static file serving, and Vite dev mode support

serving.name: serving
serving.description: Authenticated proxy to Databricks Model Serving endpoints

--template-dir.description: Path to the template directory containing the app scaffold

--config-dir.description: Path to the output directory for the initialized app

--profile.description: Databricks CLI profile to use for authentication

never: Modify files inside the template directory
Hardcode workspace-specific values in template files
must: Use the template manifest (appkit.plugins.json) as the source of truth for available plugins
Respect requiredByTemplate flags when presenting plugin selection
Generate .env files with all required environment variables from selected plugins
When discovering volume resources, prompt the user for catalog and schema before listing volumes.
